entries.name: Weather Fetcher
entries.description: Get current weather conditions for any city worldwide
entries.long_description: Fetches real-time weather data from OpenWeatherMap API. Supports current conditions, forecasts, and location-based queries. Returns temperature, humidity, wind speed, and conditions description.
entries.author: MIX Team

entries.name: Web Scraper
entries.description: Extract text content from any URL or web page
entries.long_description: Retrieves and parses web pages, extracting clean text content while stripping HTML markup, scripts, and styles. Supports configurable selectors and output formats. Handles encoding detection and redirects.
entries.author: MIX Team

entries.name: Code Generator
entries.description: Generate boilerplate code from natural language templates
entries.long_description: Creates boilerplate code in multiple languages (Python, TypeScript, Go) from natural language descriptions. Includes templates for APIs, CLIs, data models, and tests. Follows best practices and project conventions.
entries.author: MIX Team

entries.name: Translator
entries.description: Translate text between languages using LLM
entries.long_description: Translates text between any language pair using the configured LLM provider. Supports batch translation, auto-detection of source language, and context-aware translations that preserve tone and meaning.
entries.author: MIX Team

entries.name: Summarizer
entries.description: Summarize long text or documents concisely
entries.long_description: Generates concise summaries of long text, articles, or documents. Supports configurable summary length, key-points extraction, and multi-document summarization. Preserves critical information while reducing verbosity.
entries.author: MIX Team

entries.name: Calculator
entries.long_description: Safely evaluates mathematical expressions and equations. Supports basic arithmetic, trigonometric functions, logarithms, and unit conversions. Validates input to prevent code injection. Returns results with precision control.
entries.author: MIX Team

entries.name: File Organizer
entries.description: Organize files by type, date, or custom patterns
entries.long_description: Scans directories and reorganizes files based on configurable rules: by extension, creation date, name patterns, or custom classifications. Supports dry-run mode for safe preview before moving. Handles duplicate detection.
entries.author: MIX Team
